about.title: About
about.note: Content synthesized from site metadata (the live /about route redirects to home). Based on llms-docs branding: 'Tantra AI Labs — Open-Weight AI, Built From Scratch' / 'Build with Astra AI Gateway'.
about.intro: AI Subscription is an AI Application Infrastructure Foundation: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint routing 42+ models — text, vision, image generation and video — with pay-as-you-go wallet billing and guaranteed structured output.
highlights: One endpoint. Every model — automatic failover, zero-buffering streaming, per-second video generation.
Pay-as-you-go wallet billing from one balance; live balance metadata in every response.
OpenAI, Claude and cURL compatible — works with any OpenAI/Anthropic SDK.
Guaranteed structured output via JSON Schema guided decoding.

docs.title: Build with Astra AI Gateway.
docs.subtitle: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint. 42+ models — text, vision, image generation and video — with pay-as-you-go wallet billing and guaranteed structured output.

sections.title: One endpoint. Every model.
sections.body: Astra AI Gateway routes your requests across 42+ state-of-the-art models with automatic failover, zero-buffering streaming and per-second video generation — all billed from one pay-as-you-go wallet.
sections.note: Set base_url = "https://api.aisubscription.shop/v1" in any OpenAI / Anthropic SDK. Auth accepts Bearer, X-Astra-Key or x-api-key.

sections.title: Three ways to pass your key.
sections.body: Every endpoint accepts the same key in three header styles — pick whatever your SDK prefers.

sections.title: JSON Schema. Guaranteed.
sections.body: Add response_format with a JSON Schema — the output is schema-valid by construction via guided decoding. No code fences, no prose, no parsing hacks.
sections.note: strict: true — full schema enforcement, no drift. json_object mode — simple "must be JSON" without schema. max_tokens ≥ 2000 — reasoning models think before emitting JSON.

sections.title: Text to video, $0.10/second.
sections.body: Submit a job, poll the status, play the MP4 — signed URL included in the status response, valid for one hour, playable directly in any browser.
